page_title: EVE 1-3 WHU | Everton v West Ham 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Substitution. Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Emerson walks off.
90+7' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohammed Kudus walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Johnson (West Ham).
90+5' 1 - 3 Edson Alvarez (West Ham) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and sends in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
90+5' It will be a corner kick for Everton.
90+3' Substitution. Chermiti (Everton) in, Abdoulaye Doucoure out.
90+3' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Dwight McNeil (Everton) is replaced by Lewis Dobbin.
90+3' Michail Antonio (West Ham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+2' Jordan Pickford (Everton) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+2' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Craig Pawson pulls out a yellow card.
90+1' 1 - 2 What a brilliant finish! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and slams the ball into the top left corner. Unstoppable shot!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
88' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
86' Michail Antonio (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but Jordan Pickford punches the ball away.
85' The linesman raises his flag. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is adjudged offside.
84' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sees the run of Jarrod Bowen and tries to slip the ball to him, but Jordan Pickford sees the danger and gathers.
82' Andre Gomes (Everton) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
80' Lucas Paqueta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Michail Antonio (West Ham).
80' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Andre Gomes (Everton) replaces Jack Harrison.
80' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alphonse Areola.
79' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mohammed Kudus.
76' A pass from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) coming on for Beto.
74' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
74' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) dribbles into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
73' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.

71' The ball from the resulting corner kick slipped through the box to Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), who instantly fires a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but his attempt is blocked. So unlucky.
70' James Garner (Everton) takes the corner.
70' Beto (Everton) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Alphonse Areola makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
69' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' Substitution. James Ward-Prowse will be replaced by Kalvin Phillips (West Ham).
66' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
65' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jordan Pickford, who smothers the ball.

65' Dwight McNeil (Everton) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

62' 1 - 1 Kurt Zouma (West Ham) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet a cross the corner kick and scores with a great header into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
62' Corner kick. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is ready to send the ball into the box.
60' A tremendous drive by Dwight McNeil (Everton) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Alphonse Areola makes a brilliant save.

56' 1 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! James Garner showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Beto (Everton) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 1:0.
54' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' A pass by Amadou Onana (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' A lofted cross from Jack Harrison (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
51' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' A snap shot by Dwight McNeil (Everton) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola produces a good save to thwart him.
47' An attempted cross from Jack Harrison (Everton) is cleared.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a cross in and finds Kurt Zouma inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Beto (Everton) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
44' Beto (Everton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' It’s a PENALTY to Everton after the VAR review!
43' Referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
43' That looked a certain handball by Kurt Zouma (West Ham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
41' James Garner (Everton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Craig Pawson no option but to blow his whistle.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
39' Jack Harrison (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
37' The corner kick from James Garner (Everton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
37' A cross into the box from Dwight McNeil (Everton) is cleared. Everton win a corner.
37' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
35' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
35' A cross from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
34' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
34' James Garner (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
33' Dwight McNeil (Everton) passes the ball onto Vitali Mykolenko, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
29' Emerson (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' The ball is cleared after Emerson (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' James Garner (Everton) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
25' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kurt Zouma (West Ham) brought his opponent down. Free kick. Everton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' Beto (Everton) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alphonse Areola.
24' Amadou Onana (Everton) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
22' Jack Harrison (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.

19' The corner lands on the head of Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
18' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
18' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
16' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
15' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
15' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) sends a long ball in, but Jordan Pickford comfortably gathers the ball.
13' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is about to take a corner kick.
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
13' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
11' Jordan Pickford is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Edson Alvarez (West Ham), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
9' James Tarkowski (Everton) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
9' Everton players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
7' A cross by Amadou Onana (Everton) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
1' The first half has started.
Everton will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Craig Pawson.
